articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

articles.title: Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) has dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900, giving back Monday's jump and lagging the stock market's rebound from last week's selloff.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.snippet: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
articles.snippet: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.
